assets.name: Club morning
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: small editorial photograph for GameTime's Fieldwork Glass iPhone fitness challenge app, to be cropped into a short wide 3:1 banner or a small square thumbnail. Primary request: a quiet, candid club-morning moment of two adult friends walking side by side outdoors. Scene: pale warm-chalk paved path beside deep green grass. Subject: only their lower bodies from mid-thigh down, natural walking strides, understated unbranded cream and dark forest-green sportswear, socks and realistic unbranded walking/running shoes. No faces. One pair of legs has medium brown skin, one has lighter skin. Composition: landscape 3:2, closely framed at shoe height with both pairs of shoes fully visible in the central middle third, plenty of real pale pavement across the frame; humans occupy about half the image width; clean decisive composition legible at 80px, warm natural side light and believable soft shadows. Style: premium editorial sports-club photography, tactile real fabric and pavement, relaxed everyday movement, no staged victory. Color palette: harmonize with warm chalk #F5F3EC, deep club green #193B32, warm cream #F4F5DE, only a tiny muted citrus #D9EE92 detail. This is an atmospheric illustration of movement, not a user photo or proof of activity. No text, no logos, no watermark, no app UI, no medals, no money, no decorative glass, no glossy advertising finish.

assets.name: Stride print
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small editorial raster graphic for GameTime Fieldwork Glass, a friendly athletic challenge iPhone app. Primary request: an expressive but restrained vintage sports-publication screenprint of a walking stride, suitable for cropping to a short 3:1 banner and a small square thumbnail. Scene: warm chalk paper #F5F3EC. Subject: two realistic cropped lower legs and unbranded running shoes in a relaxed walking stride, shown diagonally across the middle in an editorial photomontage/screen-print treatment. Shoes and anatomy remain believable. Medium: two-color photographic halftone screenprint, visible fine ink grain, off-register ink edge, tactile sports-club annual aesthetic, dense forest-green #193B32 photographic silhouette and one restrained citrus #D9EE92 offset shadow shape; cream highlights. Composition: landscape 3:2, central main stride occupying middle 55% of height, generous warm-paper breathing space above and below for flexible crops, bold shoe silhouette easily read at 80px. Refined art direction with intentional contrast and sparse composition. This is an atmospheric graphic, not a route, chart, progress gauge or activity proof. No text, no logos, no numbers, no watermark, no app UI, no trophies, no coins, no fitness pressure, no generic cartoon character, no 3D, no gradients, no shiny glass, no decorative tiny stars.

assets.name: Lace up print
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. assets.name: Running print
